payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how audio and text sequences are combined in the RNN model.

claims.text: The model uses dual recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to independently encode audio and text sequences, then combines their outputs using a feed-forward neural network to predict emotion classes.

The audio-RNN encodes audio features, while the text-RNN encodes the word sequence of the transcript, and their final hidden states are concatenated to form a combined representation for emotion classification.
An attention mechanism is proposed to focus on specific parts of the text transcript that are relevant to the audio information, enhancing the model's predictive capabilities.
